text: Casio Computer Co., Ltd. is listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. Its major shareholders as of 31 March 2026 were The Master Trust Bank of Japan (trust account) with 15.70%, Custody Bank of Japan (trust account) with 8.37% and Nippon Life Insurance Company with 5.78%; Kashio family members and their trust account hold single-digit percentages.
short: Casio is listed in Tokyo; top holders are trust banks and an insurer.
